title: Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat on iOS: choose style and format, and apply a brand kit, for visual creations
summary: Hold: the checklist says membership of the brand manager group alone grants publishing rights, but Microsoft requires both brand kit policy checks to be satisfied. The documented control paths and commands are supported, and the page correctly distinguishes the planned iOS release from the documented desktop and web feature.

claims.quote: Enterprise Brand Manager policy | Who can publish, edit, and manage official brand kits. | Members of the brand manager mail-enabled security group specified in the policy.

claims.claim: Group ownership alone does not grant official brand kit publishing or editing rights.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Security & identity; Governance controls
claims.claim: The two policies are independent, and publishing a personal kit as official requires satisfying both checks.
claims.quote: The policies are independent. To publish a personal brand kit as an official brand kit, a user must satisfy both policy checks.

claims.claim: A brand manager outside the creation group cannot create or edit brand kits under the documented policy configuration.
claims.quote: C | No | Yes | Can't create or edit brand kits because the creation policy requirement isn't satisfied.

claims.claim: When Restrict brand kit creation is enabled, users outside its group do not see the create-brand-kit option.

claims.quote:

Your admin has restricted the rights for brand kit creation and editing. Please contact your admin for permission.
